{{Quote|The rest of us Gamorreans speak in complete sentences! Why can't you?|translated=1|[[Rogua]], criticizing Gartogg|<ref name="And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>}}
'''Gartogg''' was one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] nine [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards. He was unintelligent even for a Gamorrean and had a knack for coming across murdered corpses ([[Ak-Buz]], [[Phlegmin]], [[Gonar]], and a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monk]]).

==Biography==
[[File:GamorreanGuard-AE.png|thumb|left|Gartogg]]

Gartogg took it upon himself to investigate [[Phlegmin]]'s murder and continued to carry his rotten corpse everywhere he went. He desperately wanted to ride on the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], and [[Ortugg]] and [[Rogua]] said they'd let him if he solved the murder. After finding the corpse of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monk]], he began to carry it around as well. He finally concluded that [[Dannik Jerriko]] had killed Phlegmin. Although this was true, Ortugg didn't let him go on the sail barge.

After the sail barge exploded, Gartogg left [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and began working for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring, still carrying the mummified corpses of Phlegmin and the B'omarr monk everywhere he went.
